correctness.rationale: Every shattered m≥3 support forces m distinct private coordinates, so m≤k. At m=k they exhaust the free axes; a two-positive trace forces k−2 spare axes, giving d≥2k−2. Exact constructions realize every trace and uniquely count 2^d binom(d,k) maximal supports. Each splitting all-positive query introduces a fresh axis, so online depth≤k+1. At d=2k−1 a uniform-subset containment tree provides depth k in the positive root branch, and a k-shattered support in the opposite facet provides depth k in the negative branch. Included reproducible enumeration and 16-leaf certificate check finite cases independently. Assumptions d≥k≥3, finite discrete cube and rank exactly k were checked; no extrapolation from finite code is made.

originality.rationale: The theorem concerns all fixed-rank coordinate faces as a set system on cube vertices, equivalently conjunctions of exactly d-k consistent signed literals. The primary subcube-partition source addresses partitions into faces, not incidence shattering for the full face class. The partial-cube source uses a different primal embedding invariant, and the zero-set source gives full linear-combination zero-set families. Standard variable-width conjunction classes do not imply this fixed-width threshold, count, and online rank. No checked published result implied the joint claim; this is a best-knowledge comparison, not a complete priority certification.
residual_risks: An earlier theorem phrased in terms of exact-width signed conjunctions, homogeneous Boolean terms, or dual uniform subcube incidence systems may have been missed.
No independent historical-priority verification was performed; findings from partial excerpts alone are not global absence claims.

value.rationale: Determines an infinite family’s sharp maximal VC threshold, classifies and enumerates every largest shattered support, and establishes a sharp static/online separation with a one-ambient-coordinate transition between saturation regimes. The private-coordinate rigidity and two-coordinate online decision gadget are structural explanations, not routine reparameterizations or a one-off small census.
